newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Anscor advises against Reynolds IPO.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Anscor advises against Reynolds IPO.

text.p: Manila brokerage firm Anscor Hagedorn Securities Inc said on Monday it is advising investors not to susbcribe to the initial public offering (IPO) of Reynolds Philippines Corp due to its high price and high income projections for next year.
Reynolds is the country's sole manufacturer of aluminum sheets and foil. It is planning an IPO of 238 million shares in January 1997.
"We believe that the issue is priced at an unjustifiably high level and recommend investors not to subscribe to the offering," said Russell Ong, analyst at Anscor.

According to Anscor, with a reportedly 5.55 peso per share price, the issue's price earnings ratio is at 11.7 times the projected 1997 earnings, at par with the manufacturing sector's PER of 11.9 times.
Anscor said it deemed as "too optimistic" the company's projected 64 percent increase in net income for 1997 at 332 million pesos from the estimated 1996 full year profits of 202 million pesos.

"The 1997 income projections are highly dependent on earnings it will be realising from its new ventures, a very aggressive forecast considering that the units it is banking on heavily are as yet in the start-up stage," said Ong.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418939 fax 8176267
